markdown: The finite-stage audit found one more carrier-level issue: the package does not store an arbitrary family of overlap pieces. It uses the canonical affine intersection for each ordered chart pair, indexed by `charts ⊕ (charts × charts)`, with separate restriction, reversal, and triple-transition families. I’m correcting that description and adding the exact finite-Galois typeclass binders; this is the last prose pass before validation and an early commit.
